comparison: structure_T256 minus fixed_T256 (same questions, model, prompt, reasoning and output settings)

answer_f1.metric: official QASPER answer F1 (max over annotations), per question
answer_f1.ci: 95% paired bootstrap, clustered by paper, 10,000 reps, seed 7
answer_f1.decision: 'better' if CI lower bound > 0; 'non-inferior' if lower bound > -0.05; 'degraded' if CI upper bound < -0.05; otherwise 'inconclusive'

faithfulness.metric: RAGAS 0.4.4 Faithfulness, judge openai/gpt-oss-20b, 19 frozen questions x 2 configs
faithfulness.decision: reported with the same paired, paper-clustered CI; no claim if inconclusive

missing_failed_truncated: reported separately; questions missing in either config are excluded from paired comparisons and counted
quota_rule: after the first generation response: continue only if x-ratelimit-remaining-requests >= 1.25 x remaining planned requests and the provider did not report a daily-token or paid-tier condition; pace to the per-minute token window; stop on any daily-limit 429

budgets.reservation: prompt chars/3 + requested completion limit, checked before every request

faithfulness_addendum.decided_after: 1 faithfulness score observed (compatibility check); before any other
faithfulness_addendum.rule: answers that are model abstentions ('Unanswerable') contain no claims, so Faithfulness is undefined: they are recorded as skipped (not judged) and counted separately; means and paired comparisons use questions scored in both configurations
